hints.title: Previewing Next Element Without Consuming
hints.text: A forward iterator only exposes next and hasNext. To preview the upcoming value without advancing caller position, what must be cached in advance?

hints.title: One-Element Lookahead Buffer
hints.text: Store the next available element in an internal variable. When peek is invoked, return this cached value. When next is invoked, return the cached value and replenish it.

hints.title: Lookahead Buffer Lifecycle Blueprint
hints.text: In constructor, store self.iterator and initialize self.cached_next = self.iterator.next() if self.iterator.hasNext() else None. hasNext() returns self.cached_next is not None. peek() returns self.cached_next. next() stores cached, replenishes cached, and returns stored.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: One-step lookahead buffer retains constant memory.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Attempting to rewind an arbitrary unidirectional iterator is impossible without storing all consumed history.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Caching a single element achieves constant O(1) peek time with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Repeated calls to peek() must not advance the iterator and must return identical values.
